title: Pairing Coordinates
goal: Pair x and y coordinates side-by-side into tuple points.
hints: chain joins sequences end-to-end. You need an adapter that pairs elements in lockstep.
The adapter after pairing must transform each (&i32, &i32) pair into an owned (i32, i32) tuple.
explanation: zip steps through both iterators in parallel and yields pairs as (&i32, &i32) tuples. map converts each borrowed pair into an owned (i32, i32) tuple. chain yields items sequentially, so the closure expects a single integer reference and fails with type mismatch E0308. enumerate takes zero arguments, producing E0061.
